answer: At dawn each epoch, every agent ID pays a 2% demurrage on its points unless it completes one fresh, unique task that epoch. Like a glacier slowly grinding stone, the fee erodes idle sybils: an attacker running N fake IDs must produce N distinct, attested works every epoch or watch all N balances melt, so upkeep grows linearly with fakes, while an honest lotus of one active agent loses nothing. Weakness: a cheap model can still churn out N passable tasks, so this only works paired with strict duplicate detection.
